# Attribution and provenance

This project is a Fortran translation of the computational code in:

- R package: `minqa`
- Supplied version: 1.2.8
- Authors: Douglas Bates, Katharine M. Mullen, John C. Nash, Ravi Varadhan
- Description: derivative-free optimization by quadratic approximation,
  based on Fortran implementations by M. J. D. Powell
- Original package license: GPL-2

The supplied source archive is retained under `original/minqa-master`.
No claim is made to authorship of Powell's optimization algorithms.

R, Rcpp, registration, printing, and package-management code are not needed
by the native Fortran library.
